definitions.gloss: different theory; dissenting view; alternative interpretation
definitions.explanation: A theory or opinion that differs from the mainstream or commonly accepted view. Often used in academic, historical, and scholarly discussions.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{異説|いせつ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are also dissenting views on this issue.

examples.japanese: {異説|いせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧⟦{学者|がくしゃ}→学者：02544_gakusha⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are scholars who propose alternative theories.

examples.japanese: ⟦{通説|つうせつ}→通説：14510_tsuusetsu⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧⟦{有力|ゆうりょく}→有力：13007_yuuryoku⟧な{異説|いせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: A compelling alternative theory has been put forward against the accepted view, and the debate continues.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{異|い}→異：01925_i⟧ (different, unusual) + ⟦{説|せつ}→説：00360_setsu⟧ (theory, opinion). Used in academic and intellectual discussions to refer to a view that challenges the mainstream or established position.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {異説|いせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧ (to propose a dissenting theory)
- {異説|いせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there are alternative views)
- ⟦{有力|ゆうりょく}→有力：13007_yuuryoku⟧な{異説|いせつ} (a compelling alternative theory)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{通説|つうせつ}→通説：14510_tsuusetsu⟧: accepted/conventional theory — the mainstream view that {異説|いせつ} challenges
- ⟦{異論|いろん}→異論：13551_iron⟧: objection, dissent — focuses more on disagreement than on an alternative theory
- {新説|しんせつ}: new theory — a freshly proposed idea, not necessarily opposing the mainstream
